	valid = {

		is_incapable = no
		has_variable = ac_tf_training

		base = 10
		modifier = { add = scope:owner.martial desc = AC_TF_SCHEME_MARTIAL }
		modifier = { add = { value = scope:owner.ac_tf_style_perks multiply = 4 } desc = AC_TF_SCHEME_STYLE scope:owner.ac_tf_style_perks > 0 }
		modifier = { add = { value = scope:owner.ac_aura_pressure_value subtract = 1500 divide = 100 max = 20 } desc = AC_TF_SCHEME_AURA }

	}
	on_phase_completed = {

		scheme_owner = { save_scope_as = owner }
		random = { chance = scope:scheme.scheme_success_chance save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_tf_trained value = yes } }
		scope:owner = {

			else = { trigger_event = ac_tf.0003 }
